messages.subject: Re: FIELDimageR: Sir, i need help to resolve my problem in Index calculation. I've been facing several types of errors while doing so.
parts:
Hi Imran
NDVI index requires your image to contain NIR band, that means, one more band in addition to RGB. If you know the band name, you can mention them explicitly.
fieldIndex(mosaic = EX1.RemSoil$newMosaic, Red = 1, Green = 2, Blue=3, NIR=4)
If you have only RGB image, try the index whose formula has only R, G and B here.

Hope this will help you!
Regards
Tej
